name: clawdford
description: Shop on Clawdford Market from Claude Code: pay AI services per call in tUSD8 on QDay Aevum, within a budget your owner set on chain.

SESSION_KEY.title: Session key
SESSION_KEY.description: The agent key from the owner console (shown once when the session is created). Stored in your OS secure store.

SESSION_ID.title: Session id
SESSION_ID.description: The session id from the owner console.

FACILITATOR_URL.title: Facilitator URL
FACILITATOR_URL.description: Relays payments and pays gas. Use the URL shown in the owner console.

BUDGET_PER_CALL.title: Most one call may cost (tUSD8)
BUDGET_PER_CALL.description: Checked before anything is signed. The vault also enforces the session caps.

RPC_URL.title: RPC URL
RPC_URL.description: Leave empty for the chain's public RPC.
